templates.legible: Legible (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Red Hat Mono)

appearance.previewText: Cenacle shows your messages like this: calm, readable, yours.
appearance.fontsHint: WOFF2, WOFF, TrueType or OpenType, up to 2 MB, five at most. Only you see them; check the font's license allows it.
appearance.fontAdded: The font is added. Choose it under My own combination.
appearance.fontLimit: You have five fonts; remove one first.
appearance.fontInvalid: Use a WOFF2, WOFF, TrueType or OpenType font of up to 2 MB.
appearance.saveFailed: Your appearance could not be saved.

auth.title: Sign in to Cenacle
auth.subtitle: Use your Cenacle ID account to continue.
auth.help: No account yet? Ask your administrator to create one.
auth.signOutFailed: Signing out did not work. Check your connection and try again.

cancelled.title: Sign-in was cancelled.
cancelled.reason: You left Cenacle ID before signing in.

expired.title: This sign-in has expired.
expired.reason: A sign-in works once and for 15 minutes.
expired.action: Start again with the button below.

failed.title: Sign-in could not be completed.
failed.reason: The answer from Cenacle ID could not be verified.
failed.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, give your administrator the error code.

unavailable.title: Cenacle ID can't be reached right now.
unavailable.reason: The sign-in service is starting up or unreachable.

chat.channelIntro: Everyone in this channel can read its messages.
chat.tooFast: Not sent: you're going a little fast. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
chat.reconnecting: Reconnecting… New messages appear when the connection is back.
chat.offline: You're offline. Messages you send are kept and can be sent again.
chat.deleteFailed: The message could not be deleted. Try again.
chat.editFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
chat.noChannelsHint: Open a channel from the list, or browse the channels of this workspace.

channels.createDescription: Channels are where people talk about one topic.
channels.name: Name
channels.everyoneHint: Everyone becomes a member, also people who join later.
channels.nameTaken: A channel with this name exists.
channels.browseDescription: Open a channel you are in, or join another one.
channels.notMember: You're not a member of this channel.
channels.notFound: This channel doesn't exist or is not available to you.
channels.readOnly: Only announcements are posted in {{channel}}. You can read everything here.
channels.mandatory: Everyone is a member of this channel.
channels.leaveFailed: Leaving did not work. Check your connection and try again.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.publicHint: Everyone can find and join it.
visibility.privateHint: Only members see it; its managers add people.

channels.addPeoplePrivate: Only the people you add can see this private channel.
channels.addPeoplePublic: They become members and see the channel in their list.
channels.findPeople: Find people by name or e-mail
channels.changeFailed: The change did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
channels.settingsDescription: Name, topic and who can find the channel.
channels.defaultStaysPublic: Everyone is a member of this channel, so it stays public.
channels.configuredName: This channel's name is set in the installation settings.
channels.archivedNotice: This channel is archived. You can read it, but no one can post.
channels.archiveDescription: Members can still read it, but no one can post, and it leaves the sidebar.
channels.archiveImpact: Its managers can unarchive it at any time; nothing is deleted.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Categories group channels in everyone's sidebar. Channels without a category stay under Channels.
categories.nameTaken: A category with this name exists.
categories.deleteDescription: Its channels stay and move under Channels.

workspaces.leaveDescription: You leave all its channels too.
workspaces.leaveImpact: You can come back only with a new invitation.
workspaces.lastOwner: A workspace keeps at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
workspaces.settingsDescription: Name and members. Owners and admins run the workspace's channels.
workspaces.name: Name
workspaces.addDescription: Join a workspace with an invitation link, or create a new one.
workspaces.appearanceHint: What people of the workspace see unless they choose their own.

invites.title: Join {{workspace}}
invites.subtitle: You were invited to this Cenacle workspace.
invites.invalidTitle: This invitation can no longer be used.
invites.invalidReason: It has expired, been used up or revoked.
invites.askAgain: Ask for a new invitation link.
invites.dialogDescription: Anyone with the link and a Cenacle ID account can join while it is valid.
invites.copyFailed: Copying did not work; select the link and copy it.
invites.linkHint: The link is shown only now. Share it only with the people you invite.

dm.title: Direct messages
dm.newDescription: Pick one person for a direct conversation, or up to 8 for a group. The same people always meet in the same conversation.
dm.full: A conversation has up to {{count}} other people.
dm.intro: This is the start of your conversation with {{people}}.

about.direct: Only the two of you see this conversation.
about.group: Only the people in this conversation see it. Its people are fixed; start a new conversation to add someone.

presence.failed: Your status could not be changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.securityHint: Two-step verification and your password are managed in Cenacle ID.
settings.endFailed: The device could not be signed out.
settings.endAllDescription: Cenacle signs you out on your devices; open apps close their connection at once. Drafts stay on each device. To use Cenacle there again you sign in again.
settings.keepThisDevice: Keep me signed in on this device

reactions.label: Reactions
reactions.chipMine_one: {{emoji}}: {{count}} person, you. Take your reaction back
reactions.chipMine_other: {{emoji}}: {{count}} people including you. Take your reaction back
reactions.failed: The reaction could not be saved.

bots.title: Integrations
bots.titleDescription: Bots post into {{workspace}} through tokens and webhooks.
bots.name: Name
bots.disabledNotice: This bot is disabled: its tokens and webhooks do not work until it is enabled.
bots.addToChannels: Add the bot to channels like a person (channel details → Add people); webhooks add it to their channel.
bots.disableDescription: Its tokens and webhooks stop working until you enable it again. Its messages stay.
bots.changeFailed: The bot could not be changed.
bots.tokensHint: For programs that act as the bot: send as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
bots.revokeDescription: Programs using it can no longer act as {{bot}}. Create a new token first if one should keep working.
bots.webhooksHint: A secret address that posts into a channel as the bot: JSON like {"text": "…"}, or Jira events.
bots.deleteWebhookDescription: Its address stops working; whatever posts to it gets an error. Messages it posted stay.
bots.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it.
bots.shownOnce: Shown only now: keep it somewhere safe. Anyone who has it can post as the bot.
bots.rotateDescription: A new token with the same name and scopes is created. The current one keeps working for a while, so programs can switch without a gap.
bots.commandsHint: Slash commands people type in any channel of the workspace. Cenacle sends a signed POST to the address and shows the answer.
bots.deleteCommandDescription: People can no longer use it. Messages it posted stay.
bots.signingSecret: The signing secret: check the X-Cenacle-Signature header with it (see the integrations guide).
bots.eventsHint: Cenacle sends signed POSTs to the address when something happens in the channels the bot is a member of. Failed deliveries are retried.
bots.deleteSubscriptionDescription: Events stop going to {{url}}, and its delivery log goes away.
bots.resent: It will be sent again shortly.
bots.resendFailed: It could not be sent again.

webhookCreatedFor.jira: The webhook address. In Jira: System → WebHooks → Create, paste it as the URL and pick issue created, updated, deleted and comment created.
webhookCreatedFor.gitlab: The webhook address. In GitLab: Settings → Webhooks → Add new webhook, paste it as the URL and pick push, merge request, pipeline, issue and comment events.
webhookCreatedFor.alertmanager: The webhook address. In Alertmanager, add a receiver with webhook_configs: - url: <this address>.

commands.label: Commands
commands.unknown: There is no {{command}} command here. To send text that starts with a slash, begin it with //.
commands.failed: The command did not work. Check your connection and try again.

scheduled.title: Send later
scheduled.description: Pick when the message goes out. You can cancel it until then.
scheduled.emptyDescription: Write a message first to schedule it. Here is what is already scheduled.
scheduled.cancelFailed: It could not be cancelled. Try again.

files.title: Files
files.tooMany: A message can carry up to 10 files; the others were left out.

error.upload_incomplete: The upload did not finish. Try again.
error.files_disabled: Files are not set up on this server.
error.rate_limited: Too fast. Try again in a moment.
error.too_many_uploads: You have 50 unsent files; send or remove some first.

groups.title: Directory groups
groups.workspaceHint: People in these Cenacle ID groups join the workspace with the role you choose, at sign-in and when the directory changes.
groups.channelHint: People of these groups in the workspace join the channel.
groups.managed: Members are exactly the people of these groups

profile.deactivated: No longer has access. Their messages stay.
profile.messageFailed: The conversation could not be opened.
profile.statusFailed: Your status could not be changed.
profile.statusDescription: Shown next to your name and on your profile.
profile.pictureInvalid: Use a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image (an animated GIF of at most 2 MB).
profile.saveFailed: Your profile could not be saved.
profile.invalid: Check the username and the time zone.
profile.pictureTooLarge: Pictures may be up to 5 MB.
profile.editDescription: How others see you in Cenacle.
profile.pictureHint: Square works best. Animated GIFs stand still for people who reduce motion.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameHint: Your name comes from Cenacle ID.
profile.usernameHint: 2 to 30 letters a-z, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
profile.usernameManaged: Your username is your sign-in name in the company directory.
profile.showLastSeen: Show others when I was last online

uiTexts.description: Replace a few texts of the interface for everyone (for example to name your organisation). Empty fields keep the original.
uiTexts.failed: The texts could not be saved.
uiTexts.hint: The original is shown in each empty field. {{channel}} stands for the channel's name.
